annotations.title: Get a drug, gene or topic and its papers

description: Use this for questions about one drug, supplement, gene, process or disease, such as: is there human evidence for this intervention; has the finding been replicated by independent labs; in which species; what trials test it and how many have posted no results; who funds the work and which companies are tied to it; what the newest papers on it report. Takes a type and key from find_entities (intervention rapamycin, disease sarcopenia). Returns the entity with the papers that involve it, newest first, and the role it plays in each. For an intervention, a gene or a process, `evidence` gives its evidence as structure, never as a grade: the species its findings reach and whether independent labs found the same there, the labs and countries behind them, the findings against, its trials and those with no results posted, its funders and its company ties. The counts are of the papers AgingResearch.News has read, not of all the literature. Not for personal medical advice or doses.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page. Keep the other parameters the same.

min_relevance.description: Lowest aging-relevance score for the papers listed. Default: no filter.

name: get_entity
